description: The first-run walkthrough: three static screens and a close button. It reads the theme (`theme-read`: `get_theme` only), so this page paints the owner's actual theme rather than always opening in the default one. It cannot read the event stream, the approval queue, memory, or anything else Jarvis does: it holds no event permission (in Tauri 2 a page's global listen() hears every event the app sends, even one sent to another window) and not `jarvis-link`, which reads the approval queue. The only write it is capable of is marking itself seen.
